entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-31
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ILLink takes exponential time on deep interface hierarchies #136766
  • ZipArchive Update mode corrupts Zip64 entries after a metadata-only change #136763
  • Utf8Parser.TryParse(..., out int, ...) is slower than the other integer overloads because TryParseInt32D is too large to inline #136761
  • ConfigurationBinder: 4x slower Get<T>/Bind in .NET 11 RC3 from IsDefined(inherit: true) per property per bind #136759
  • Test failure: IdsConversionsWithRegionTest America/Vancouver America/Los_Angeles mismatch #136758
  • VerificationException in generic static abstract interface implementation with constrained generic method #136757
  • Regex sourcegen fails with CS0759 when member inside file scoped class #136754
  • [browser] Backport #134124 to release/10.0 (Task-returning [JSExport] leaks a Promise per call) #136753
  • [API Proposal]: BitOperations.Interleave / BitOperations.Deinterleave #136750
  • Counter Intuitive Means Of Finding "Package-Identifier" For `dotnet new details` #136749
  • CancellationTokenSource.CancelAsync leaves WaitHandle undisposed when no callbacks are registered #136748
    12.0.0
  • Microsoft.DotNet.Helix.Sdk.MonoQueue.targets(79,5): error : IOException: The process cannot access the file chrome.dll #136747
  • Setting Environment Variable on Process Started as Other User Uses Wrong Environment #136746
  • ConcurrencyLimiter: a waiter cancelled during a release can leave a free permit that a queued request never gets #136745
  • TcpClient.Connect might throw `NullReferenceException` on macOS #136744

Closed

  • [browser][coreclr] R2R native relink publish fails with NETSDK1152 #136499
    12.0.0

    Future
  • JIT: (bug) [ARM64] LSRA consecutive-register wraparound filter accepts V31,V0,V1 while V1 is busy (assert "Not sufficient consecutive registers available") #135508
    12.0.0
